    threshold = case['threshold']
    calls = case['calls']
    accepted_call_ids = []
    diagnostics = []
    for call in calls:
        call_id = call['call_id']
        loss_without = call['loss_without_call']
        loss_with = call['loss_with_call']
        parseable = call.get('parseable', True)
        if loss_without != 0:
            normalized_gain = (loss_without - loss_with) / loss_without
        else:
            normalized_gain = 0.0
        accepted = parseable and (normalized_gain >= threshold)
        if accepted:
            accepted_call_ids.append(call_id)
        diagnostics.append({'accepted': accepted, 'call_id': call_id, 'normalized_gain': normalized_gain})
    return {'accepted_call_ids': accepted_call_ids, 'diagnostics': diagnostics}"}
